instruction: 請就下列題目，用1-7量表指出你的同意程度。
instruction_en: Please indicate your agreement with each statement using a 1-7 scale.

text: 我認為擁有健康比什麼都有價值。
text_en: I value being in good health above everything else.

text: 我尊重與我有互動過的權威人士。
text_en: I have respect for the authority figures with whom I interact.

text: 即便我非常不贊同團體成員的意見，我依舊會避免與他們爭論。
text_en: Even when I strongly disagree with group members, I avoid an argument.

text: 我的快樂有賴於周圍人們的快樂。
text_en: My happiness depends on the happiness of those around me.

text: 為了所屬團體的利益，我會犧牲自己的利益。
text_en: I will sacrifice my self-interests for the benefit of the group I am in.

text: 無論和誰在一起，我的行為舉止都一致。
text_en: I act the same way no matter who I am with.

text: 我偏好用直接了當的方式與剛認識的人互動。
text_en: I prefer to be direct and forthright when dealing with people I've just met.

text: 在做教育/職業的規劃時，我會考慮父母的建議。
text_en: I should take into consideration my parents' advice when making education/career plans.

text: 被單獨挑選出來表揚或獎勵，我覺得挺舒服。
text_en: I am comfortable with being singled out for praise or rewards.

text: 即使在所屬團體中過得不開心，但如果他們需要，我還是會留下來。
text_en: I will stay in a group if they need me, even when I am not happy with the group.

text: 我能和初次見面的人坦誠交談，即使這個人比我的年齡大得多。
text_en: I feel comfortable using someone's first name soon after I meet them, even if they are much older than I am.

text: 我最關心的是把自己照顧好。
text_en: Being able to take care of myself is a primary concern for me.

text: 我所屬的團體保持融洽，對我而言很重要。
text_en: It is important for me to maintain harmony within my group.

text: 在公共汽車上我會把位置讓給我認識的教授。
text_en: I would offer my seat in a bus to my professor.

text: 有生動的想象力對我而言很重要。
text_en: Having a lively imagination is important to me.

text: 我經常覺得與他人的良好關係勝過自己的成就。
text_en: I often have the feeling that my relationships with others are more important than my own accomplishments.

text: 在很多方面，我很享受自己是獨一無二且和別人不同的。
text_en: I enjoy being unique and different from others in many respects.

text: 如果我的兄弟姐妹失敗了，我覺得自己也有責任。
text_en: If my brother or sister fails, I feel responsible.

text: 我尊重那些謙虛地看待自己的人
text_en: I respect people who are modest about themselves.

text: 對自己的認同感，並不依賴於他人，對我而言非常重要。
text_en: My personal identity, independent of others, is very important to me.

text: 在課堂上說出自己的意見，對我而言並不困難。
text_en: Speaking up during class is not a problem for me.

text: 我寧願直接說「不」，也不願冒被誤解之險。
text_en: I'd rather say "No" directly, than risk being misunderstood.

text: 我在家裡和在學校裡（或在工作中）行為一致。
text_en: I am the same person at home that I am at school.

text: 尊重所屬團體的決定，對我來說很重要。
text_en: It is important to me to respect decisions made by the group.
